paite: Joshua ahong upata a, ahong tek mahmahta hi. TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Na hong upa in na hong tek mahmahta a, gam lak ding lah atam lai mahmah ngal a.
heading: Gam Lak Lai Ding
english: Now Joshua was old and well advanced in years. Yahweh said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and there remains yet very much land to be possessed.

paite: Hiai gamte ahi lak louh: Philistia gam tengteng leh Geshur gam tengteng.
english: “This is the land that still remains: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;

paite: Aigupta gam chin a om Shihor a pan mallam pang a Ekron gamgi tan in, huai tuh Kanaan mite gam a sim ahi; Philistiate vaihawmtu ngate, Gaza mite, Ashdod mite, Ashkelon mite Git mite leh Ekron mite: simlam a Avi mite.
english: from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even to the border of Ekron northward, which is counted as Canaanite; the five lords of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avvim,

paite: Kanaan mite gam tengteng leh Zidon mite gam a Mearah, Amorte gamgi Aphek kho pha in.
english: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the border of the Amorites;

paite: Gebal mite gam leh nisuahna lam Lebanon gam tengteng Hermon tang nuai Baal-gad a pan Hamath kholutna pha in.
english: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath;

paite: Lebanon a pan Misrephoth-maim mun pha in, tanggam a teng tengteng, Zidon mi tengteng. Amaute Israel suante ma ah ka delhkhe dia; ka hon thupiak bang in Israel gouluah ding in bawlsak in.
english: all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out from before the children of Israel. Just allocate it to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.

paite: Huchi in hiai gam nam kuate leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte gouluah ding in hawmsak in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”

paite: TOUPA sikha Mosi in amau a dia asehsak bang in Reuben suante leh Gad suante'n Manasseh nam kimkhat dangte toh Mosi piaksa Jordan suahlam gam ah goutan aneita uhi.
heading: Jordan Suahlam Gam Hawmna
english: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them:

paite: Huai gam ahihleh Arnon Phaizang gei a om Aroer a pan leh phaizang laitak a khopi leh Medeba phaigam tengteng, Dibon tan ahi.
english: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;

paite: Amorte kumpipa Sihon, Heshbon a vaihawm a tu khopi tengteng Ammon suante gamgi tan ahi.
english: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;

paite: Gilead gam leh Geshurte leh Maakathte gamgi chiang leh Hermon tang tengteng leh Bashan gam tengteng Salkah kho tan ahi.
english: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;

paite: Astaroth leh Edrei a kumpipa a tu Bashan gam kumpipa Og gam tengteng toh, huaite Rephaim nam milian khosuaksunte ahi uh; huaite Mosi in ana dou a, ana delhkheta hi.
english: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.

paite: Himahleh Geshurte leh Maakathte Israel suante'n adelhkhe kei ua; Geshurte leh Maakathte tuni tan in Israelte lak ah atengden lai uhi.
english: Nevertheless the children of Israel didn’t drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day.

paite: Levi namte kia ahi gouluah ding a piak louh. Akiang ua ana gensa bang in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian a dia mei a thillatte amau gouluah ahi.
english: Only he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The offerings of Yahweh, the God of Israel, made by fire are his inheritance, as he spoke to him.

paite: Reuben suante nam a-inkuan dungzui in Mosi in gam ana peta hi.
heading: Reuben Gam Tan
english: Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.

paite: Agamgi uh Arnon Phaizang a om Aroer a pan phaizang laitak a khopi leh Medeba phaigam tengteng a pan,
english: Their border was from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba;

paite: Heshbon leh huai phaigam a khopi tengteng; Debon, Bamoth-baal leh Beth-baal-meon;
english: Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the plain; Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,

paite: Jahaz, Kedemoth leh Mephaath;
english: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

paite: Kiriathaim, Sibmah leh phaizang a tang a om Zereth-sahar;
english: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley,

paite: Beth-peor leh Ashdot-pisgah leh Beth-jeshimoth;
english: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, Beth Jeshimoth,

paite: Phaigam khopi tengteng, Heshbon a vaihawm Amorte Kumpipa Sihon lalgam teng, Mosi in ana thah khitsa Midiante kumpipate Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur leh Reba omna gam toh ahi.
english: all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.

paite: Beor tapa Balaam, aisan siam leng a-inkuante toh Israel suante'n athat uhi.
english: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword, among the rest of their slain.

paite: Reuben suante gam chiang bel Jordan leh apang teng ahi. Hiai gam leh akhopite leh khuate ahi Reuben suante a dia a-inkuan omdan bang zel a gouluah dia asehsak uh.
english: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.

paite: Mosi in Gad suante a-inkuan dungzui un gam apia hi.
heading: Gad Gam Tan
english: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.

paite: Agamgi uh Jazer khua leh Gilead gam khopi tengteng leh Ammon suante gam kimkhat, Rabbah kho kiang a om Aroer pha in;
english: Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near Rabbah;

paite: Heshbon a pan Ramath-mizpeh leh Betonim pha in; Mahanaim a pan Debir gamgi pha in;
english: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;

paite: Guam ah Beth-aram, Beth-nimrah, Sukoth, Zaphon, Heshbon kumpipa Sihon gam teng, Jordan leh agei a gamte, Jordan gal suahlam pang a Kinereth Tuipi tawp chiang tan in ahi.
english: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.

paite: Hiai Gad suante a dia a-inkuan omdan bang zel a agouluah ding ua seh, akhopite uh leh akhuate uh ahi.
english: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.

paite: Mosi in Manasseh nam kimkhatte gam apia hi. Manasseh nam kimkhatte a dia a-inkuan omdan bang zel a piak ahi uh.
heading: Suahlam A Manasseh Gam Tan
english: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.

paite: Agamgi uh Mahanaim a pan Bashan gam tengteng. Bashan gam kumpipa Og gam tengteng leh Bashan gam a Jair khopi tengteng toh, kho sawmguk ahi.
english: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.

paite: Gilead gam kimkhat leh Bashan gam kumpipa Og gam a Astaroth, Edrei; huai Manasseh tapa Makir suan Makir suan kimkhatte a dia a-inkuan uh omdan bang zel a seh ahi.
english: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.

paite: Hiaite Moab phai, Jeriko zawn, Jordan gal lehlam a, Mosi in gouluah dia a piak gamte ahi uh.
english: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.

paite: Levi chite Mosi in gouluah ding ape kei hi. Akiang ua ana gensa bang in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian agouluah uh ahi.
english: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. Yahweh, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.
